Mission.name: Quarry Heavy Machinery Haul
Mission.summary: Take the waiting quarry tractor and haul the staged heavy-machinery trailer up to the Grand Senora quarry.
Mission.description: A heavy-machinery lowboy is already coupled to a waiting road tractor at the docks and needs to reach the quarry yard intact. Take the staged packer, haul the armytrailer2 into the quarry drop zone, then clear the area so yard crews can take possession.
